caseName: Atchison, Topeka & Santa Fe Railway Co. v. Board of County Commissioners
caseNameFull: Atchison, Topeka & Santa Fe Railway Company v. Board of County Commissioners of the County of Douglas, State of Colorado
summary: Appeal from the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. S. T. Bledsoe, Mr. Gardiner Lathrop and Mr. Henry T. Rogers for appellant., Mr. A. L. Doud and Mr. B. C. Hilliard for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction .upon the authority of Phillips v. Negley, 117 U. S. 665, 671; Covington v. First National Bank, 185 U. S. 270; MacFarland v. Byrnes, 187 U. S. 246; United States v. Beatty, 232 U. S. 463. The petition for a writ of certiorari is denied.
